The '''NEEDLE remote slicing unit''' was designed by the [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Schism Collective]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A NEEDLE unit was mounted on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and allowed [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to wreak havoc with enemy ships' systems.
